title: An empty category row shows the ShopView Review hint
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Make sure the test location is connected to QuickBooks Online and that AccountingHub is not enabled.
  • Have a new No Charge category for this test, category A.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The QuickBooks page opens.

Step 2:

  • Category A's row shows the hint "Not set. Parts cost of [category A's name] work orders posts to the ShopView Review account until you pick one."
  • The row is not filled from another category's row.

Words in square brackets in a message stand for the value they name, such as the work order's number or the customer's name exactly as it is saved; every other word of the message must match exactly.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11762 (Story 5, QuickBooks Online account mapping)

  • S5-R4: “While a category row is empty, the row shows the existing empty-row hint with the text "Not set. Parts cost of [category] work orders posts to the ShopView Review account until you pick one." There is no fallback from one row to another. While the setting is off, empty rows show no hint.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Mapping row empty | "Not set. Parts cost of [category] work orders posts to the ShopView Review account until you pick one." | Inline hint on the row, persists”
  • S5-E2: “If a category row is empty, the parts cost of that category's work orders and lines posts to the ShopView Review account (S5-R4); there is no fallback from one category row to another.”
